organization.name: Plausible Insights OÜ
organization.notes: Uku Taht started Plausible December 2018; paid subscriptions launched 2019. Official About explicitly states self-funded, profitable and no outside investors. Operator Plausible Insights OÜ registered Estonia; project start is not asserted to be exact corporate incorporation date.

pricingTiers.name: Community Edition
pricingTiers.notes: No vendor license fee; CE differs from Cloud and requires own infrastructure.
No public designation or verified amount found in reviewed pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Business
pricingTiers.notes: Cloud Business card at 10 k monthly pageviews displays $19/month; extraction includes monthly/yearly toggles without selected-state evidence, so actual monthly-billed/annual total not asserted. CE does not include all Cloud business features.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Cloud Enterprise explicitly Custom/Contact us; not a CE license charge.

moats.claim: Privacy-focused brand and simple dashboard workflow differentiate adoption, while forkable code limits exclusive control over the engine.

productReasons.claim: Single-page traffic dashboard emphasizes quick interpretation of referrers, pages and campaigns.
Cookie-free, aggregate analytics allows measurement without cross-site visitor profiling.
Goals and custom events let teams measure conversions while keeping the reporting interface compact.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project/company sources; no separate corporate sponsor verified. Verified business steward supplied as fallback.

requirements.notes: Metadata database in stable pinned compose; not interchangeable with Click House.
Event database in stable compose; both Postgres and Click House required.
Optional deployment configuration; not necessary for all analytics collection.

requirements.condition: Only when these integrations are enabled
requirements.notes: Separate configuration routes; not mandatory core services.

resources.notes: Official repository prerequisites; storage depends on retained traffic, no fixed disk requirement supplied.

selfHosting.notes: Verified CE 3.2.1 Compose path: app+Postgre SQL+Click House. No separate Redis/queue required by compose. Built-in TLS enabled by HTTP/HTTPS configuration or use reverse proxy.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official deployment instructions; no verified one-click option found. Manual container instructions are not one-click.
